_comment: Generic evidence envelope for T1 item 8 (Characterization report),
ANALOG partition. Issue #339. Shape: klayout-tools' docs/cli/signoff.md,
'Generic evidence (opt-in, non-`klt`-native)' (klayout-tools#1152).
Item 8 is the ONLY T1 item that accepts a `generic` citation, and since
klayout-tools#2044 it accepts `generic` and nothing else.
THIS FILE IS A CLAIM, NOT A MANIFEST EDIT. `klt signoff` re-derives
nothing from a generic envelope -- it reads `status` and, if the manifest
pins one, `provenance.input.content_hash`. Everything else below is
written by a human (or an agent acting as one) who re-read the document
this wraps. `status: "pass"` therefore asserts something no tool
checked, which is why `assertion` records WHO re-read WHAT, AGAINST WHICH
COMMIT, and -- most importantly -- what the pass does NOT mean.
WHAT THIS `pass` MEANS: an aggregated, current, per-spec-row
characterization artifact exists for the analog partition, every row
carries a dated citation to the append-only record behind it, and a
human re-read it against `assertion.reread_commit`.
WHAT IT DOES NOT MEAN: that the design passes. THREE RATIFIED ROWS FAIL
in the document this wraps -- ENOB @ Nyquist (8.855 bits worst,
governing extracted, against `> 9.0`), SFDR @ Nyquist (60.41 dB worst
against `>= 62 dB`), and Area (0.151827 mm^2 against `< 0.1 mm^2`).
Whether the block passes its corner set is T1 item 5, which is `unmet`
on both partitions in the committed report and is a DIFFERENT ROW ON
PURPOSE. A reader who takes this `met` for 'the ADC meets spec' has
misread the checklist; a repo that lets them is dishonest.
`provenance` is OPTIONAL for a generic envelope, and is given here so
the manifest's `content_hash` staleness pin has something to match:
without it, a pinned hash renders the item
`unmet`/`unverifiable_provenance` rather than a false pass. The hash is
the sha256 of sim/characterization-summary.md as committed. The grader
cannot re-hash it (a generic envelope's author picks their own field
names, so `input_verified` is null by construction); `python3
signoff/run_signoff.py --check` re-hashes the committed file directly on
every pull request instead -- the same place the repo-side check is
stronger than the grader's for the digital DRC citation.
The digital partition's half of the same document is asserted
SEPARATELY, by characterization-summary.digital.json, because the
manifest keys every citation per partition and the two halves are claims
about different silicon. See ./README.md.
summary: Analog partition: sim/characterization-summary.md is current and complete against README.md#target-specification -- one row per ratified spec line, each with its latest verified value, its verdict and a dated citation. PASS IS ABOUT THE REPORT, NOT THE DESIGN: three ratified rows (ENOB, SFDR, Area) FAIL in it, which is T1 item 5's question, not item 8's.

assertion.scope: sim/characterization-summary.md, sections: 'Freshness', 'Per-spec-row status', 'What is not yet measured, stated rather than silently dropped'. The 'Digital partition (sar_ctrl_a)' section is OUT of this envelope's scope and is asserted by characterization-summary.digital.json.
asserted: Every row of README.md#target-specification has exactly one row in the document's per-spec-row table, verified row-by-row against README at the re-read commit. The V_CM row (DR-0026, added to README by PR #262) was the one missing row and was added by this pass.
Every record path the table cites resolves to a committed file, checked mechanically.

Every cited record is the current head of its campaign's `Supersedes` chain, or is explicitly labelled superseded/historical where it is not. Two drifted citations (the Clock row's superseded 06bad60; the Resolution/Latency/Interface rows' pre-DR-0014 96c2ea7) were re-pointed by this pass.

The currency defect sim/t1-checklist-reread-20260825.md section 8 named against the `Gain error, mismatch` row (issue #239) is settled: the row reads `PASS as built` at sigma_to_spec = 3.13, citing the post-resize governing record, and its stated reason no longer contradicts its own document or README. #239 is closed.
The document's Freshness banner names the commit it was actually re-read against.
not_asserted: That the design meets its ratified target spec. It does not, on three rows -- ENOB, SFDR and Area -- all stated in the document and all graded by T1 item 5, which is `unmet`.

That the numbers in the document are correct. This envelope asserts aggregation and currency; correctness rests on each cited append-only record, which is where the methodology, the full PVT grid and the raw per-corner data live.
That every non-ratified caveat in the document is current. The document's own 'What is not yet measured' section is the list of known gaps and is part of the claim, not an appendix to it.

That the whole document has been re-read since `reread_commit`. The rows listed in `assertion.partial_updates` were re-derived and re-cited at a later commit; the rest of the document carries the `reread_commit` vintage.
known_gaps_carried: Comparator-inclusive (ADC_BLOCK) statistical offset population not run (issue #89 scope item 2).
No klt yield envelope of the INL/DNL row at DR-0019's built C_u; PR #149's envelope is at the superseded pre-resize C_u = 17.24 fF.
klt pex structurally blocked for every block this repo extracts (klayout-tools#1030) -- T1 item 7.
Direct CMRR measured at +/-50 mV and linearly extrapolated to the ratified +/-100 mV band.

The V_CM row's full-PVT re-run against a real V_cm network (#358) is DONE and the row cites it: no ratified row moves outside its bound, on the schematic or on the extracted netlist the INL/DNL row is cited from. Three gaps are carried forward rather than closed: ENOB/SFDR and the extracted power deck were not re-run against the network (both wired into sim/vcm-full-pvt/run_full_pvt.sh, reasons in sim/vcm-full-pvt/README.md); the extracted arms were taken on the PRE-#381 extraction vintage (076d545), which issue #381 / PR #390 superseded while #358 was open, so the V_cm delta has NOT been re-taken on the current governing extraction (#392); and DR-0026 itself remains PROPOSED, not operator-ratified.
